checks.name: installed command help
checks.stdout:
Install optional runtimes: still-shift setup browser|soundtrack|depth

Still Shift v0.1.1

Usage:
  npx still-shift animate --input <path> --output <path> [options]
  npx still-shift animate-scene --scene <prepared.json> --output <path> [--format landscape|vertical]
  npx still-shift soundtrack validate|inspect --project <project.json> [--json]
  npx still-shift soundtrack edit --project <project.json> --revision <number> --operations <edits.json|->
  npx still-shift soundtrack render --project <project.json> --output-dir <fresh-dir> [--stems] [--range start:end]
  npx still-shift soundtrack retime --project <project.json> --revision <number> --passage <plan.json>
  npx still-shift soundtrack package --project <project.json> --output-dir <fresh-dir>
  npx still-shift soundtrack from-passage --passage <plan.json> [--narration <audio>] --output <new-project.json>
  npx still-shift passage lint --plan <plan.json> --format vertical
  npx still-shift passage import-narration --plan <plan.json> --narration <audio.wav|mp3> --timing <words.json|captions.srt> --mode match|add --output <new-plan.json>
  npx still-shift sfx generate --provider elevenlabs --id <slug> --prompt <text> --duration <seconds> --output-dir <new-directory> [--prompt-influence 0.3] [--loop true|false]
  npx still-shift prepare-commerce --brief <brief.json> --output <prepared.json>
  npx still-shift comp preview --input <composition.json|program.ts> [--watch] [--port 4173]
  npx still-shift comp validate --input <composition.json|program.ts>
  npx still-shift comp export-json --input <composition.json|program.ts> [--output <composition.json>]
  npx still-shift comp render --input <composition.json|program.ts> --output <path> [--backend canvas2d|webgl2] [--format prores4444|png8|png16|h264|hevc10|prores422hq|vp9alpha] [--transport png_pipe|raw_rgba] [--workers 1|2|3|4] [--cache-static true|false]
  npx still-shift comp export-json --scene <family-scene.json> [--output <composition.json|program.ts>] [--normalized true]
  npx still-shift comp normalize --input <composition.json|program.ts> [--output <composition.json|program.ts>]
  npx still-shift comp bake --input <composition.json|program.ts> [--output <composition.json|program.ts>]
  npx still-shift comp lint --input <composition.json|program.ts> [--policy <policy.json>] [--pixels true|false] [--backend canvas2d|webgl2]
  npx still-shift batch --manifest <jsonl> --output-dir <path> [--format landscape|vertical] [--concurrency 1|2]

The default adapter writes a validated 1080p H.264 MP4 and scene manifest.

Options:
  --duration <seconds>   3-8 seconds (default: 5)
  --fps <integer>        fixed at 30 FPS
  --format <name>        landscape (default) or vertical
  --focus <x,y>          normalized focal point for vertical crops (0–1)
  --preset <name>       auto, slow_push, horizontal_drift, cinematic_float, locked_hold, story_settle, panel_reveal, comparison_step (default: auto)
  --intensity <name>    subtle, standard, strong (default: standard)
  --seed <integer>      unsigned 32-bit seed (default: 1842)
  --adapter <name>      webgl (default) or noop (compatibility fixture)
  --help                 show this help
  --version              show the package version

Batch exits 0 after processing every item, including recorded item failures, and 2 for invalid configuration.
Completed items with matching request and artifact hashes are reused on retry.

SFX generation uses ELEVENLABS_API_KEY from the server environment and consumes account credits.
SFX duration: 0.5–30 seconds. Prompt influence: 0–1. Loop defaults to false.
Each SFX request needs a fresh output directory; paid requests are never automatically retried.
